notes.title: Deck Dash Devlog #1 - Live Stream
notes.content:
We’re going live during Steam Next Fest (Feb 25) to showcase Deck Dash, share gameplay insights, and discuss the future of the game. Don’t miss it!

[h3]What to Expect[/h3]

[b]Gameplay Commentary[/b] – Watch live battles with dev insights.
[b]Feature Discussion[/b] – Upcoming mechanics and improvements.
[b]Community Q&A[/b] – Share feedback and ask questions.

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2829750/Deck_Dash/]Play Now & Join the Stream![/url][/h3]
Try Deck Dash during Steam Next Fest and be part of the journey.

[h3]How Deck Dash is Played[/h3]

Deck Dash is a fast-paced strategy game that blends engine-building with auto-battler mechanics. Players build their decks by selecting powerful cards, each with unique abilities and synergies. Before each round, players strategically position their cards on the board, considering their effects and interactions. Once the battle begins, cards activate automatically based on their placement, triggering attacks, defenses, and special abilities. Players can also merge identical cards to upgrade their effects and unlock powerful passive abilities, leading to dynamic and evolving strategies. Adapting to opponents and optimizing deck synergy is key to claiming victory.

[h3]Next Fest Event Highlights[/h3]

[b]Feb 24: Featured Deck[/b] – Try pre-built decks and earn rewards.
[b]Feb 26: Proving Grounds[/b] – Max damage challenge in 6 turns.
[b]Feb 27: Harsh Survival[/b] – No HP resets, last as long as you can.
[b]Feb 28: All-in Brawl[/b] – Battle with your entire collection.
Coming Soon: Rogue-like Mode – A fresh, strategic challenge!

[h3]Join the Discussion[/h3]
We’d love to hear your thoughts! Join our community and tell us about your experience:

💬 Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/CXVS5Vg59U]Discord[/url]
🐦 Follow us on X: [url=https://x.com/ArvisOfficial]X[/url]

notes.title: Deck Dash is Part of Steam Next Fest – Play the Demo Now!
notes.content:
[b]Deck Dash[/b] is joining Steam Next Fest February 25 edition, and we need your feedback to make it the best experience possible! This is your chance to try the game early, test strategies, and help shape its future before the full release.

[h3]Why Your Feedback Matters[/h3]
[b]Balance & Improvements[/b] – Your input helps us fine-tune mechanics, combos, and game balance.
[b]New Features & Fixes[/b] – Tell us what you love and what could be better.
[b]Be Part of the Community[/b] – Join fellow strategy enthusiasts and help build the best version of Deck Dash.

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2829750/Deck_Dash/]PLAY THE DEMO NOW[/url][/h2]

[h3]Gameplay Overview[/h3]
Deck Dash blends engine-building strategy with auto-battler mechanics, challenging players to create, optimize, and adapt their decks in fast-paced battles.

[list]
[*] [b]Deck Building & Strategy:[/b] Players start by assembling a deck from their collection, focusing on synergy and strategy.
[*] [b]Tactical Card Placement:[/b] Before each round, players strategically place their cards, considering their abilities and interactions.
[*] [b]Auto-Battler Combat:[/b] Once the turn starts, cards play automatically, executing their abilities based on placement and conditions.
[*] [b]Merge & Evolve:[/b] Identical cards can be merged to increase their power and unlock unique passive abilities, making every match different.
[*] [b]Adaptive Strategy:[/b] As battles progress, players must adjust their decks, leverage synergies, and counter opponents to claim victory.
[/list]

[h3]What’s in the Demo?[/h3]
[b]Strategic Deck Building[/b] – Construct decks that evolve through battle.
[b]Auto-Battler Action[/b] – Your cards play automatically, but smart planning wins the fight.
[b]Unique Game Modes[/b] – Try All-in Brawl, Harsh Survival, Proving Grounds, and Featured Deck.
[b]Merge & Inspire Mechanics [/b]– Combine cards for stronger effects and new playstyles.

[h3]Next Fest Event Calendar[/h3]
Deck Dash offers a variety of gameplay experiences. During Next Fest, a new event will unlock each day, allowing you to explore different and engaging gameplay options. Here’s the Next Fest event calendar for Deck Dash:

[b]24th February: Featured Deck[/b]
Each day, play with a designated deck to try out cards that will be unlocked in the future and earn rewards.
[b]26th February: The Proving Grounds[/b]
Test your skills in this challenge mode. How much damage can you deal to a puppet in six turns?
[b]27th February: Harsh Survival[/b]
Enter a series of matches where your HP does not reset between battles. How long can you survive?
[b]28th February: All-in Brawl[/b]
Fight with your entire collection—no deckbuilding required. Show everything you’ve got.
[b]Coming Soon: Rogue-like [/b]
This mode will be available in the coming days of the Next Festival.
